direction: Calm scholarly interfaces, neutral tonal surfaces, soft corners

contracts.border: Use tonal separation for cards; keep visible keyboard focus
contracts.bilingual: Paragraph base direction with isolated Arabic phrases in Latin prose
contracts.sourceText: Keep raw evidence and clipboard text unchanged
contracts.verification: Passing tests do not establish live authentication or payment success

aiRefinement.flagshipPlacement: AI page only; entry opens five-AI function picker

scienceCards.composition: Cairo 700 measured to 85% width behind content, no reserved footer

aiRefinement.profile: compact identity and factual expiry; icon-only appearance, labelled ID EN AR languages
aiRefinement.loader: four rounded folios, 1800ms linear phase with theta - .45 sin(theta); painter listens directly
aiRefinement.catalog: default flexible editorial list; 70/30 identity-metadata on desktop, stacked on phone; optional grid
aiRefinement.calendar: structured day/month/year from one snapshot; equal columns and divider
aiRefinement.webview: retain native view behind recoverable error overlay; no decorative minimum delay
aiRefinement.dashboard: greeting card contains last-session resume; full-width statistics panel separate from adab
aiRefinement.paymentSuccess: receipt with confirmed invoice and amount; no unverified access activation claim
aiRefinement.generalAiActions: centered 72x48 icon pill plus separate 48x48 reference circle; native icon semantic labels and independent keyboard focus
aiRefinement.legal: stable document and section IDs, full offline ID/EN/AR, live locale resolver
